signals.CBE: Cbe (F) from per-bias OP (HBT AC pass)
signals.CBC: Cbc (F) from per-bias OP (HBT AC pass)
signals.CIN: input capacitance (F) from Y11 @ 10 GHz (HBT AC pass)

shape: signal arrays are (n_geo, n_vce, n_vbe); axes are 1-D
notes: gm/go/beta recomputed from Ic,Ib after DC; VBIC @q[gm] etc. often freeze under nested dc wrdata. HBT Cbe/Cbc/Cin/fT come from a separate OP+AC pass (10 GHz |h21|, not nested-dc wrdata). PNP/lateral devices skip AC; FT/CIN remain NaN.
